The cloud harness blocks foreground 'sleep N' chained with commands; waiting on long solver runs needs run_in_background until-loops or Monitor, which the long-commands note could say.

notes: New eval/odd-orbit.py: for n = 3k+1 (k even), a permutation g of three k-cycles; one wait-free night taking exactly one pair per full orbit of g, turned k times, plus the half-turn pairs and {3k, bye} as the last round, is a whole wait-free season. 19 on 3x9 SAT in 22.9 s, 25 on 4x9 in 141 s (both previously open after whole-season, cyclic and packing attempts). Stored in odd-designs.mjs (23 designs). Through the tool (eval/odd-cyclic-check.mjs, seeds 1-3): 19 teams 171 -> 0 waits, 25 teams 281 -> 0. doubleheader.test.mjs extended with both sizes: 32/32 pass locally. odd-night-sat.build gained fix_round0 (default on, no behaviour change).
